announcements.title: Welcome to WorkUp
announcements.summary: Thanks for downloading WorkUp! Track your workouts, nutrition, and body stats, and watch your progress unfold.

sections.title: Log your first entry
sections.body: Tap "Start Workout" on the home page, or record today's weight and height to build your data foundation.

sections.title: Announcements keep coming
sections.body: Version updates, events, and important notices will show up here. Check back from time to time.

announcements.title: Need Help? Contact Us
announcements.summary: If you have any questions or suggestions, go to Settings > Contact Us to reach out.

sections.title: How to Contact Us
sections.body: Open the app, tap "☰" in the top left corner, then select "Settings" > "Contact Us" to submit your questions or suggestions.

sections.title: We Value Your Feedback
sections.body: Whether it's feature suggestions, usage questions, or bug reports, we'll read every message and respond as soon as possible.
